verdict.rationale: Workable lists a custom report builder (a single pricing-page line) and documents a REST API for pulling data out. That API returns collections of jobs, candidates, events, requisitions and stages and claims to give 'full control over your data', so programmatic extraction is possible. It is a general data API, not a reporting or warehouse export: you would have to build your own pipeline, and nothing shows report output being exportable. missing for 10: scheduled exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a dedicated reporting/analytics API, documentation of report-builder depth or export formats, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse
